learning_objective: 🎯 Journey into the rugged hills of Maharashtra to uncover the inspiring story of the Marathas, their brilliant warfare, and their powerful empire!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The story of the Marathas begins with their legendary leader, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. He united the Maratha people and carved out an independent kingdom with a powerful army, a strict justice system, and a deep respect for all religions.

The Marathas were brilliant fighters! They used the rugged hills of the Western Ghats to their advantage. They perfected 'guerrilla warfare'—making quick, surprise attacks on their enemies and then vanishing back into the mountains.

A strong kingdom needs a smart government! Shivaji Maharaj set up an advisory council of eight brilliant ministers called the Ashtapradhan to help him run the administration, collect taxes fairly, and keep the people happy.
After Shivaji Maharaj, the Peshwas (Prime Ministers) took charge. Under their leadership, the Maratha army marched in all directions, creating a massive empire that stretched across most of India!

fun_activity.title: 🏰 Build Your Own Fort!
fun_activity.instructions: Forts were the heart of the Maratha Empire. Use old cardboard boxes, clay, or building blocks to create your own mini hill-fort. Give it a powerful Marathi name like Raigad or Pratapgad!

quick_recap: ⭐ Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj founded the powerful Maratha Empire in the 17th century.
⭐ The Marathas used the rocky geography of the Western Ghats for surprise guerrilla attacks.
⭐ The kingdom was smoothly run by a council of eight ministers known as the Ashtapradhan.
⭐ Under the rule of the Peshwas, the Marathas became the most powerful force in India.
⭐ They built incredible forts to protect their territories and citizens.
